name: Fairy Tail Re:Write
source:
"Even with all of these people, how many I've run into, their laughter, how much they complain about others at work, whatever new constructs they build, it never feels…. Normal." 

Streets car blurring. The clanking of glasses. The everyday sonder of the soul. Things all people have become accustomed to over the years. All expect Natsu Dragneel. A young man where every day is fulfilled by pouring drinks and empty tram rides. Like a descending Autumn leaf, he floats alone in the cold wind. Memories of the past reflect like mirrors, and every time he sees himself, he'll always know. But some mirrors show us a chance to find what we're looking for, and for Natsu, that's the only thing he could have faith in. But will it be the same thing once he finds it, or will this all finally be enough? 

Fairy Tail Re: Write is a fan-made visual novel to re-imagining the popular anime series Fairy Tail with a new and exciting frame of reference.

[From [url=https://loosethoughts.itch.io/fairy-tail-rewrite]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“即使遇见过这么多人，听过他们的笑声，看过他们在工作中如何抱怨彼此，也见识过他们新造出的各种东西，一切还是从未……显得正常。”

街道飞驰而过，玻璃杯碰撞作响，灵魂里那份日常的惊奇感。多年来，所有人都已习惯这些事。唯独不包括纳兹·多拉格尼尔。这个年轻人每天的生活都被倒酒和空荡的电车行程填满。他像秋日飘落的叶子，独自浮在寒风中。过往的记忆如镜面般映照，每当他看见自己，总会明白一切。然而，有些镜子会让我们有机会找到所寻之物。对纳兹而言，那是他唯一能寄托信念的东西。可他找到之后，仍会是同一件事吗？这一切最终会足够吗？

《Fairy Tail Re:Write》是一部粉丝创作的视觉小说，以新颖的视角重新构想广受欢迎的动画系列《妖精的尾巴》。[引自[url=https://loosethoughts.itch.io/fairy-tail-rewrite]Itch.io[/url]]
